action_summary: Restore equal-weight sigmoid-probability averaging over the five existing fold checkpoints, reversing the v22 ablation that lost 0.01648 on the leaderboard. Preserve checkpoint architecture, tokenizer settings, text concatenation, and truncation; load and release each fold sequentially, use batches of eight, remove masked trailing padding per batch, and reuse the tokenizer to control memory and inference cost. Cache each fold's test predictions, handle missing text, and validate submission shape, finiteness, range, and qa_id alignment. No training, inference, new backbones, unvalidated ensemble weights, or quantile rounding was performed; the existing five-fold result is the evidence for the expected improvement.
